sentences.en: There is one word us radio producers can never seem to let go of.
sentences.zh: 有一个词，我们广播制作人似乎永远无法割舍。

sentences.en: Our job used to be all about tape.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作曾经完全围绕着磁带展开。

sentences.en: My first Marantz recorder captured sound on cassette tapes.
sentences.zh: 我第一台马兰士录音机就是用卡带录音的。

sentences.en: If you're a little bit older than me, you even produced your stories on tape.
sentences.zh: 如果你比我年长一点，你甚至是用磁带制作故事的。

sentences.en: You'd sit in front of a reel-to-reel and cut apart someone's voice with a razor blade,
sentences.zh: 你会坐在开盘机前，用剃须刀片剪开某人的声音，

sentences.en: and then splice the magnetic tape back together with clear adhesive tape.
sentences.zh: 然后用透明胶带把磁带重新粘好。

sentences.en: These days, we use digital recorders and computers, but we still use the word tape.
sentences.zh: 如今，我们使用数字录音机和电脑，但我们仍然沿用“磁带”这个词。

sentences.en: If Sam or Katie or Avery goes out and does an interview, the first question I'll ask is,
sentences.zh: 如果萨姆、凯蒂或艾弗里出去做采访，我问的第一个问题总是：

sentences.en: The raw material that we work with is tape.
sentences.zh: 我们所使用的原材料就是磁带。

sentences.en: The story we're presenting today is about one artist who is also inextricably linked to tape.
sentences.zh: 我们今天介绍的故事，是关于一位与磁带有着千丝万缕联系的艺术家。
在这种情况下，是卡式磁带。

sentences.en: Had it not been for obsessive fans collecting and copying and passing along his songs in the era of tapes,
sentences.zh: 如果不是那些痴迷的粉丝在磁带时代收集、翻录并传播他的歌曲，

sentences.en: we might never have come to know his music.
sentences.zh: 我们可能永远不会认识他的音乐。

sentences.en: Then again, had he lived in a different era,
sentences.zh: 话又说回来，如果他生活在不同的时代，

sentences.en: perhaps he would have gotten the recognition he deserved within his own lifetime.
sentences.zh: 或许他在有生之年就能获得应有的认可。

sentences.en: From radio producer Charles Maines, this is Three Records from Sundown.
sentences.zh: 来自广播制作人查尔斯·梅恩斯，这是《日落后的三张唱片》。

sentences.en: You know, one of the things that I've said a lot, but I'm not sure how much people understand it, really,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我常说一句话，但我不太确定人们是否真的理解，
我通常不喜欢创作型歌手。

sentences.en: It's not what I choose to listen to.
You know, I grew up listening to roots music or to jazz or to, you know, music by,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我从小听的是根源音乐、爵士乐，或者，你知道，听的是……

sentences.en: I don't want to exaggerate this, but, you know, music by real people,
sentences.zh: 我不想夸大其词，但你知道，是真正的人创作的音乐，

sentences.en: by people from the earth, people who are not middle class, you know.
sentences.zh: 来自脚踏实地的人，不是中产阶级的人，你知道的。

sentences.en: And I don't think in history, you look back,
sentences.zh: 我不认为在历史上，你回顾过去，

sentences.en: I don't think there's that many examples of the middle class inventing anything, you know, culturally.
sentences.zh: 我不认为中产阶级在文化上发明过什么东西，你知道吗。

sentences.en: So when I put on a tape and I hear, you know, well-educated white person strumming a guitar,
sentences.zh: 所以当我放上一盘磁带，听到一个受过良好教育的白人在弹吉他时，

sentences.en: you know, I'm looking at my watch and I'm saying,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我会看一眼手表，然后说：

sentences.en: okay, I'll give this another 15 seconds and then, you know,
sentences.zh: 好吧，我再给它15秒，然后，你知道，

sentences.en: unless the voice is really startling.
sentences.zh: 除非他的声音真的让人惊艳。

sentences.en: And Nick Drake just grabbed me by the throat.
sentences.zh: 而尼克·德雷克一下子就抓住了我的心。

sentences.en: And it's one of the great sadnesses and frustrations of my life in the music business
sentences.zh: 这是我在音乐行业生涯中最大的悲哀和挫折之一，

sentences.en: that I wasn't able to figure out a way to get it across to people in his lifetime.
sentences.zh: 那就是我没能在他有生之年找到一种方法让人们了解他。

sentences.en: Producer Joe Boyd remembers Nick Drake.
sentences.zh: 制作人乔·博伊德回忆尼克·德雷克。

sentences.en: A vicious young American arrives to London hoping to make his mark in the thriving music scene.
sentences.zh: 一位雄心勃勃的年轻美国人来到伦敦，希望在繁荣的音乐界留下自己的印记。

sentences.en: He produces the first Pink Floyd single.
sentences.zh: 他制作了平克·弗洛伊德的第一张单曲。

sentences.en: And he discovers the English folk rock pioneers at the Fairport Convention.
sentences.zh: 他还发现了费尔波特公约乐队的英国民谣摇滚先驱们。

sentences.en: But arguably, he makes his greatest find far from the streets of London.
sentences.zh: 但可以说，他最伟大的发现远在伦敦街头之外。

sentences.en: The English have such funny names for class.
sentences.zh: 英国人对阶级有各种有趣的称呼。

sentences.en: I would call him an upper middle class boy.
sentences.zh: 我会称他为上层中产阶级的男孩。

sentences.en: You know, the upper middle class always call themselves middle class.
sentences.zh: 你知道，上层中产阶级总是自称中产阶级。

sentences.en: But, you know, the lower middle class also call themselves middle class.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，下层中产阶级也自称中产阶级。

sentences.en: Anyway, he was definitely, he went to a boarding school.
sentences.zh: 总之，他绝对是，他上过寄宿学校。

sentences.en: He spoke with a very refined accent.
sentences.zh: 他说话带着非常优雅的口音。

sentences.en: And he was part of a kind of gilded youth generation of well-off, upper middle class kids.
sentences.zh: 他是那种富裕的上层中产阶级孩子组成的“镀金青年”一代的一员。

sentences.en: And, you know, he was very talented in music.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他在音乐方面非常有天赋。

sentences.en: His mother played the piano and wrote songs.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲弹钢琴并创作歌曲。

sentences.en: And years later, I discovered, I heard tapes of his mother.
sentences.zh: 多年后，我发现了，我听到了他母亲的录音带。

sentences.en: You know, they have these wonderful chords in the piano.
sentences.zh: 你知道，钢琴里有美妙的和弦。

sentences.en: And, you know, the style of the song is a bit, you know, very English.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，那种歌曲风格有点，你知道，非常英式。

sentences.en: Very almost music hall, but upper class music hall.
sentences.zh: 非常接近音乐厅风格，但属于上流社会的音乐厅。

sentences.en: And he started playing the guitar.
And he was just, I don't know where it came from.
sentences.zh: 他简直是，我不知道他是怎么做到的。

sentences.en: But he developed a way of reproducing the guitar,
sentences.zh: 但他开发出了一种在吉他上重现的方法，

sentences.en: the kind of chords that his mother played on the piano.
sentences.zh: 那种他母亲在钢琴上弹奏的和弦。

sentences.en: I heard him first because one of the Fairport Convention
sentences.zh: 我第一次听说他，是因为费尔波特公约乐队的一位成员

sentences.en: told me about hearing him at a concert in the Roundhouse.
sentences.zh: 告诉我他在圆屋剧场的一场音乐会上听过他演奏。

sentences.en: It was a Vietnam protest concert.
sentences.zh: 那是一场反越战抗议音乐会。

sentences.en: And I followed up the lead
sentences.zh: 我顺着这条线索找到了他，

sentences.en: and invited him to come in and bring me a tape.
sentences.zh: 并邀请他过来带给我一盘磁带。

sentences.en: And he brought me a tape.
And I put it on at the end of that day
sentences.zh: 我在那天结束时放了它，

sentences.en: and just immediately knew that this was something completely different.
sentences.zh: 立刻就知道这完全是与众不同的东西。

sentences.en: A lot of retuning of strings
so that he played in very unusual tunings.
sentences.zh: 所以他演奏时使用的是非常规的调弦法。

sentences.en: And his articulation of arpeggios on the guitar
sentences.zh: 他在吉他上对琶音的清晰表达，

sentences.en: and the whole way he used the guitar to underpin his songs
sentences.zh: 以及他用吉他支撑歌曲的整个方式，

sentences.en: is completely unique in my view.
sentences.zh: 在我看来是完全独特的。

sentences.en: I mean, it's so strong and so central
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它如此有力，如此核心，

sentences.en: I mean, there's nothing about guitar solos in there.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，里面没有任何吉他独奏。

sentences.en: It's just a way of orchestrating a song
sentences.zh: 这只是一种编排歌曲的方式，

sentences.en: in a complexity that is staggering.
